messages:
Rae (People Ops): Quick flag for managers: we're introducing a temporary 'holdback' step for any packet that changes promotion eligibility during comp freeze week. Short expl + actions below.

Jules (Eng Manager): Holdback? What's the trigger for a holdback vs regular review?

Rae (People Ops): Trigger = any rating change that would alter role or comp band AND the packet is updated after comp freeze snapshot. Example: late evidence that bumps someone from "meets" to "exceeds" which impacts promotion/comp.

Omar (Head of Eng): How does this affect timelines? We can't delay everyone's signoff.

Rae (People Ops): We won't delay global signoff. Holdbacks are quarantined: the rest of the team continues through normal flow. Holdback packets go to a short panel (people-ops + 2 senior stewards) that meets within 48h to verify the change. We aim to resolve within 72h.

Ben (IC): If I'm the person affected, will I see a delay in my comp?

Rae (People Ops): Potentially brief. If panel approves the change, we fast-track an addendum to the comp packet; if not, original outcome stands. We only escalate true eligibility-impacting changes.

Jules (Eng Manager): What's the process for submitting evidence for a holdback review? Templates?

Rae (People Ops): Use the Holdback Evidence form: https://rwd.in/holdback-form (fields: packet id, summary of new evidence, artifact links, manager rationale). Paste a 2-line TL;DR into this thread for visibility.

Signoff-Bot: Reminder: comp freeze snapshot taken Fri 17:00 PT. Any packet edits after that may trigger holdback logic.

Omar (Head of Eng): Can managers preemptively flag a packet to avoid automatic holdback? e.g., we know an addendum is pending.

Rae (People Ops): Yes  mark the packet with the "pending-addendum" tag before making edits and notify people-ops in this thread. That will route it to the expedited review queue. Don't forget to include artifact links inside the form.

Ben (IC): Are these panels public? Can I request recusal if a steward worked with my manager?

Rae (People Ops): Panels are small but not secret. If you or your manager have a conflict, DM me and we'll swap a steward. We follow the same recusal rules as calibration.

Jules (Eng Manager): One more: what about external hires/overlap cases where comp band was set by recruiting recently?

Rae (People Ops): If comp was set by a recruiting compensation exception within 30 days, we treat changes differently. People-ops and comp-review must sign off together; expect a slightly longer review (up to 5 business days). We'll surface guidance in the playbook shortly.

Omar (Head of Eng): Good. Please add these bullet points to the review playbook and send a short note to managers.

Rae (People Ops): Will do. Quick summary to post: 
- Holdback triggers: edits after comp snapshot that change eligibility
- Use holdback-form for evidence
- Panel decision target: 48-72h (exceptions: recruiting overlap up to 5bd)
- Pre-mark as pending-addendum to expedite
I'll publish an FAQ and update the playbook link in this channel by EOD.
